statement: WITH base AS (SELECT *, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY registered_bev_passenger_car_stock DESC) AS bev_quartile, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY registered_bev_passenger_car_stock DESC, analysis_region_code) AS bev_rank FROM __CATALOG__.gold.vw_powerbi_region_kpi_published WHERE date_set_id = '__DATE_SET_ID__'), benchmark AS (SELECT PERCENTILE(in_service_registered_charging_points_per_1000_bevs, 0.5) AS median_points, PERCENTILE(in_service_registered_fast_charging_points_per_1000_bevs, 0.5) AS median_fast FROM base) SELECT COUNT(*) AS regions, SUM(CASE WHEN bev_quartile = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS highest_bev_quartile_regions, SUM(CASE WHEN bev_quartile = 1 AND in_service_registered_charging_points_per_1000_bevs < median_points THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS highest_bev_quartile_below_median_total_provision, SUM(CASE WHEN bev_quartile = 1 AND in_service_registered_fast_charging_points_per_1000_bevs < median_fast THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS highest_bev_quartile_below_median_fast_provision, SUM(CASE WHEN bev_quartile = 1 AND in_service_registered_charging_points_per_1000_bevs < median_points AND in_service_registered_fast_charging_points_per_1000_bevs < median_fast THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS highest_bev_quartile_below_both_medians, SUM(CASE WHEN in_service_registered_charging_points_per_1000_bevs >= median_points AND in_service_registered_fast_charging_points_per_1000_bevs < median_fast THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS above_median_total_below_median_fast, SUM(CASE WHEN bev_rank <= 10 AND in_service_registered_charging_points_per_1000_bevs < median_points THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS top_10_bev_below_median_total, SUM(CASE WHEN bev_rank <= 10 AND in_service_registered_fast_charging_points_per_1000_bevs < median_fast THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS top_10_bev_below_median_fast, CAST(CORR(registered_bev_passenger_car_stock, in_service_registered_charging_points) AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS correlation_bev_to_absolute_points, CAST(CORR(registered_bev_passenger_car_stock, in_service_registered_charging_points_per_1000_bevs) AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS correlation_bev_to_points_per_1000, CAST(median_points AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS median_points_per_1000_bevs, CAST(median_fast AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS median_fast_points_per_1000_bevs FROM base CROSS JOIN benchmark GROUP BY median_points, median_fast
